# Lenis 1.3.27 (vendored)

Smooth wheel scrolling for the desktop motion layer (`assets/js/site/motion/smooth.js`), driven by
the GSAP ticker. Loaded only on fine-pointer screens ≥ 1024 px with motion on.

- Package: `lenis@1.3.27` from the npm registry,
  <https://registry.npmjs.org/lenis/-/lenis-1.3.27.tgz>
  (integrity `sha512-QIHNH4LIfWyLfgH/5K0aTGZgyFJJ7GfHNcaH/AIgyKjb8gstLh5siNGvrVqz1w5ClLXzOvllBVk7vby8JzUVPQ==`).
- Files, byte-identical from the package: `dist/lenis.mjs` (an ES module), its source map
  `dist/lenis.mjs.map`, and `LICENSE`.
